w1.why: ₹43,700 a year for four phone calls.

w1.why: ₹6.78L collectible excluding TWC. Ask for a date, then stay quiet.

w1.why: 22% loan-to-value means real headroom. Changes the debt order if it works.

w1.why: INC-20A cannot be filed without it.

w1.why: Release deed from Geethamma’s branch plus mutation. Blocks the sale until done.

w1.title: Confirm floating rate and zero foreclosure charge on the car sanction letter
w1.why: The prepayment plan depends entirely on this being free.

w1.title: Track your actual personal spend for one week
w1.why: ₹15,000 is an estimate, and estimates are what broke the last plan.

w2.why: 100% advance month one, due by the 5th, work pauses on the 6th.

w2.title: Rank all 13 people on billing against salary
w2.why: Data first. Use the matrix in Team.

w2.title: Agree Sunny’s full number in writing with a deferred date
w2.why: Acknowledged deferred debt is safe. Unacknowledged becomes a dispute.

w2.why: A buffer without a limit stops being a buffer.

w2.why: Two premiums left, ~5% return. Continue, paid-up, or surrender.

Ask three happy clients for one referral each
